Body.Content:
The rental pricing API runs on the commerce scale unit and supports headless experiences such as rental e-commerce price queries. It calculates prices from your rental pricing rules with better performance, so every channel can get fast, more consistent results.

GA date: June CY2027

Preview date: April CY2027
